title: How Fair is Software Fairness Testing?

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical critique and analysis of existing software fairness testing paradigms, demonstrating how current metrics and datasets enforce Western epistemological traditions and proposing future evaluation methods like localized datasets, participatory co-creation, and adapting models across diverse cultural contexts.
Critical assessment highlighting the systematic exclusion of non-standard dialects, oral traditions, and Indigenous languages from standard fairness evaluation benchmarks and training data.
